1773890655.446590.description:
Soulo is an evolving music project rooted in R&B, soul, and indie fusion—built less like a fixed band and more like a fluid emotional space. The sound centers on intimate vocals, textured guitar, and minimal but intentional production, often leaving room for silence, breath, and imperfection. It leans into feelings that are hard to name—distance, attachment, quiet longing—without over-explaining them.

The project isn’t about polish or genre purity. It’s about capturing moments that feel real: slightly off, slightly raw, sometimes unresolved. Songs often start from small fragments—voice notes, late-night lines, half-finished melodies—and grow into something that holds a mood rather than a clear narrative.

Soulo is also collaborative at its core. It brings in different musicians and energies, but keeps a consistent emotional tone—soft, reflective, a little detached, but still warm. It’s less about performing for an audience and more about letting people sit inside a feeling for a while.

1774269119.536036.description:
Lars Wicklund is a Boston-area singer-songwriter crafting heartfelt, Americana-tinged songs rooted in authenticity and emotional connection. Hailing from the greater Boston community (Medford, Massachusetts), Wicklund blends elements of folk, rock, and indie storytelling into a sound that feels both timeless and deeply personal. 

Drawing inspiration from artists like John Lennon, Tom Petty, and The Avett Brothers, as well as the cinematic indie rock of The Airborne Toxic Event, Wicklund’s music carries a strong melodic sensibility paired with lyrical sincerity. His songs often explore themes of unity, perseverance, and the human experience, delivered through warm vocals and organic instrumentation. 

With releases like “Unity” and “When the Hammer Falls” in 2025, Wicklund continues to establish himself as an emerging voice in the New England singer-songwriter scene, earning comparisons to classic and modern folk-rock storytellers. 

Whether performing in intimate local venues or recording new material, Lars Wicklund creates music that invites listeners in—offering not just songs, but shared moments of reflection, resilience, and hope

1774408388.566598.description: “spider water brings together the gritty, technical sound of sequencer-based loops and the free-form nature of live jamming to communicate a symbiotic critique of modern digital relationships. The group was founded in Cambridge, MA in 2022 by college friends Dan Peluso and Chuck Stein, after their past projects proved to be fruitful in creativity. Dan wrote many of the sequences that would become the backbone of their songs between jobs, using the OP-Z pocket synthesizer, but knew he wanted to create something that could be played with live drums and other instruments. The two recruited close friends Emma Elmgren for bass and Austin Engel for guitar, and soon the band began playing live shows around the Cambridge and Somerville area. After a year of practicing the various sequences, developing them into songs, and writing a lengthy and evolving psych rock jam to break free from the chains of the OP-Z, the band finally recorded their debut album ‘exit plan’ in September 2023, which was mixed, produced and released the following year.”

1776085392.1087826.description: Olivia Cloud is a singer songwriter from Sarasota Florida. Spending her summers in the rolling hills of Vermont gives her a unique approach to folk songwriting in conjunction with her southern urban upbringing. She grew up in the theater world which comes into play with her narrative storytelling lyrics and way of performing. While her music can be found all over the internet, her goal is to cultivate meaningful face to face relationships between artist and live audience. This song is about all the things she wouldn't have if she died when she got cancer my freshman year of college. It's about all the things I thought I would never be blessed enough to experience. There was a time when she doubted my ability to live a “normal” life after treatment, so she wrote this song about her struggles. Although she still don’t know if my future lies behind a white picket fence, she is so grateful to have one.

I am a Watertown native and would love to bring a fun set to our neighborhood!

1776100334.1092029.description: Allegra Fletcher is an Afro Caribbean Latina cultural strategist, educator, and artist. Her sound reflects the multiplicity of her background, and her practice is rooted in a deep and embodied commitment to healing and transformative social justice. Allegra has received recognition for her work on numerous occasions, including being named a member of the 2021 cohort of WBUR ARTery 25, and a 2024 Dunamis Emerging Artist Fellow. Daisy Chains, her self published book of poetry, song, and reflective exercises, and its companion coloring and workbook, can both be found at allegrafletcher.com. You can follow her journey on Instagram: @allegrafletcher

1776103866.1093018.description: Middle and high schoolers covering indie rock songs from bands like nirvana, built to spill, and Radiohead

1776177459.1115993.description: Kearyoke is a fun and inclusive opportunity for joyful self-expression through singing and audience participation. Whether you're a seasoned performer or singing publicly for the first time, want to sing solo or with a friend, be a backup dancer, or be a crowd hype-person who loves cheering people on, you belong here!

Their sound is modern yet accessible, balancing sophisticated harmony and interaction with an engaging, captivating energy that connects easily with a wide audience.

1776195751.1121384.description: Leaf and Machine are all over the map of psychedelic indie, with sounds between folk, shoegaze, synthy slowcore, and Doors jams that never quite existed. Think of it like a mixtape from an old friend, spun together with the hum of a machine struggling to keep pace.

1776267764.1141626.description: Prestige Worldwide is a Back Bay based rock/pop cover band focusing on the 90s/00s. Their energetic fun live shows in the Boston/Cambridge/Somerville area have proved a hit with audiences of different ages and the group’s mission to remain faithful to the original versions have also added to and enhanced their appeal.

1776268979.1142035.description:
Winner of the prestigious Kerrville New Folk Award for Songwriting, Rob writes songs that harken to Appalachian ballads, country blues, and spirituals, as well as contemporary Americana, resulting in what has been described by Folk Radio WUMB 91.9 FM as “the rare ability to write songs that seem like they’ve always been there.” Samples from his Boston Music Award-nominated debut album, “The Honey On the Mountain,” as well as his latest release, “Jubilee,” can be heard on his website.
www.roblaurens.net

1776273711.1143580.description: Regina Bakhritdinova is a fingerstyle guitarist who sounds like a whole band on just one acoustic guitar!

1776276472.1144762.description: We are a punk/rock band from Quincy MA. Our music is heavy, melodic, and theatrical. Our songs cover topics of identity, expression, and leftism.

1776276878.1144824.description:
The King Serpent Variety Troupe is an outlaw themed performing group based in New England. With music, dance, singing, and storytelling, they have invaded a wide variety of venues and made away with the hearts of audiences young and old.
Led by director and lead writer David Breen, the King Serpent has performed on many stages around New England, including Topsfield Fair, Mahi Mahi Cruises & Charters, and Cape Cod Irish Village Hotel. Bruce Chester serves as Business Manager, co-director, and interim Music Director.  As of 2025, Doreen Marshall amd Arlene Elkins have returned to the Troupe and newcomer Tom Arena has joined us as a performer, singer and percussionist.

1776297633.1151692.description: Killer Classic Rock! Enjoy this band’s selection of the very best music from the 60’s, 70’s, 80’s and beyond. Featuring stunning, layered vocals and 3 lead singers, Perfect Crime also has authentic guitar chops and growling classic organ and piano parts. Lead guitar - Mike Onessimo, rhythm and vocals - John Copeland, keyboards and vocals - Dawn Evans Scaltreto, bass and vocals - Steve Straight, drums - Scott Mayo. Dance and sing along with your favorite FM classics!

1776299615.1152197.description: Lightning Rising is Watertown’s own classic rock act! Featuring John Copeland on guitar, Dawn Evans Scaltreto on keys, Peter Lester on drums and Agasthya Shenoy on the bass, each performer adds to the vocals. Bringing on the unexpected in melodic classic rock, expect to be wowed with selections by America, Elton John, Cowboy Junkies, the Monkees and more!

1776309794.1155491.description: Boston native, Camberville music scene relic, and proud Dubtown dweller. That haunting echo of a melody you heard in passing as a child? Yeah, I'm covering that. Last year from my own front porch I dispatched 43 songs into the midday mist, and still had plenty of tunes left in the tank. Who knows what this year holds in store?  Well, not you, if you don't show up :) So stop by, and feel free to request a song! (And yes, we'll have waters and snacks for weary porchfest adventurers.)

so+so (so and so) have been playing together in various incarnations in the Somerville/Cambridge/Medford area since 2001, as a four-piece, as a three-piece, a duo, writing their own songs and playing off-the-beaten-path covers.

In 2011, so+so released a 27-song analog recording of original music, Sparrow with a Crumb. They are ready to make a new album.

Judy and Erin each write lyrics and music, and from there everybody backs one another up. They’ve got your back, too!

1776460748.1198650.description: Formed in late 2025, Cherry Picking is a 4-piece indie-pop band that will be playing an acoustic set of original music.

I have released 2 albums of original music and have been featured on both radio and television.

1776856919.1313833.description: Featuring members of Big Barn Burning, the Stinking Badges and Union Label, Green Street Station takes classic 60’s rock, mixes it with early 70’s arena rock, throws in a healthy portion of early 80’s power pop, all built on a base of punk rock, with a spicy dash of post punk thrown in. The resulting goulash sounds a lot better than it tastes.

1776866523.1315995.description: The Patch Notes are a jazz combo from Boston, MA, built on a reverence for classic and modern video game themes. Their sets bring an improv tradition to some of the most recognizable (and just occasionally obscure) soundtracks that have graced living room televisions. Think Charlie Parker, Koji Kondo, Duke Ellington, Yasunori Mitsuda and K.K. Slider--The Patch Notes can bring them all.

1776873780.1317901.description: After Winter, these four Watertown 2nd graders switch out skis and downhill racing with rock playing familiar classics.

1776902185.1324292.description: Los Angeles-bred nomad Karmondegreen grew up ping-ponging across the map, collecting sounds like souvenirs before landing on what he calls "anti jazz." His music is a chaotic blend of hyperactive anthems, melancholy bangers, and the occasional bed squeaker. A self-proclaimed social introvert (to his friends' disagreement), Karmon channels that contradiction into songs that swing from ridiculous to heartbreaking, often within the same verse. Wielding multiple instruments, he crafts music that feels like overhearing someone's therapy session at a house party. Messy, honest, and surprisingly catchy.

1776978003.1344704.description: 90's classic/alternative rock with a touch of grunge.  All the lost classics you've been dying to hear again.

1777060744.1361789.description: The Goobers are Sydney Lavoie and Jacob Baron, a couple in love and writing funky, weird, and heartfelt songs about anxiety, being stuck in traffic, and not knowing how to do good in the world. Jacob released his debut EP under the name Jabberbob last May, and has been performing as a singer songwriter in the Boston area for the past five years at venues such as the Cantab, the Lilypad, Midway Cafe, the Jungle, and more. Prior to the Goobers, Sydney has been writing songs and singing in bands and a cappella groups for multiple decades, and wrote, produced, and released an album in 2012. Jacob is a jazz pianist and has performed with jazz groups and in a wedding band throughout New England. Both Goobers have PhDs in STEM and are preparing for the day when AI will replace them and they will be forced to earn money via their musical talents.

See the band live to feel their powerful and one of a kind energy. Experience the hard hitting, dynamic, and captivating sound that is Populace.
